page.overview:
Who is Lewis?

Lewis was Hudson's stepfather who appeared in What We Found, the third story of Fazbear Frights 8: Gumdrop Angel.

He was balding, short, and always smoked black cherry tobacco with his pipe. He wore plaid vests.

Unlike Steven, who was Hudson's biological father, Lewis is a complete opposite. Lewis is a cold, violent, pitiless brute of a stepfather. He is physically and verbally abusive towards Hudson when he was a child, brutally punishing him over the slightest of reasons for years. His assaults and actions gave Hudson severe trauma.

Lewis married Hudson's mother after Steven's suicide. He once slammed Hudson's head for not finishing his homework. When Hudson vomited the floor after smelling reflex, Lewis created a barrier at the doorway of Hudson's bedroom piling up all the toys he owned. Almost every day, Lewis physically beats him up, telling him that he was nothing.
